events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: Matt Forte ran for two touchdowns four days after complaining the Jets didn't run the ball enough, and an overwhelming defense sacked Tyrod Taylor seven times Thursday night in New York's 34-21 demolition of the Buffalo Bills.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets damage Bills' AFC East standing, 34-21

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw for 218 yards and two touchdowns, and the Tennessee Titans beat the Baltimore Ravens 23-20 Sunday for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans come off bye, win 3rd straight beating Ravens 23-20

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: The Saints extended their winning streak to six when Drew Brees completed 81.2 percent of his passes for 263 yards and two touchdowns in a 30-10 victory over reeling Tampa Bay on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kamara, Brees help Saints win 6th straight, 30-10 over Bucs

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at New York Giants

headlines.description: Jared Goff set career highs with four touchdown throws and 311 yards passing, Todd Gurley ran for two more scores and the surprising Los Angeles Rams made one big play after another in beating the defenseless New York Giants 51-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws career-best 4 TDs, Rams rout defenseless Giants

headlines.description: Carson Wentz tossed four touchdown passes, Corey Clement had three scores, and the Philadelphia Eagles routed the Denver Broncos 51-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carson Wentz tosses 4 TD passes, Eagles beat Broncos 51-23

headlines.description: Cam Newton ran for 86 yards and a touchdown and the Carolina Panthers stormed back from an early 10-point deficit and then held on to beat the Atlanta Falcons 20-17 on Sunday in a key NFC South matchup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers run for 201 yards in 20-17 win over Falcons

headlines.description: With A.J. Green and Jalen Ramsey ejected for fighting, Jaydon Mickens delivered the knockout blow by returning a punt 63 yards for a touchdown, helping the Jacksonville Jaguars beat the Cincinnati Bengals 23-7 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mickens delivers knockout blow, Jaguars handle Bengals 23-7

headlines.description: T.Y. Hilton had 175 yards receiving with two touchdowns to help the Indianapolis Colts halt a three-game skid with a 20-14 win on Sunday over a Houston Texans team that struggled without Deshaun Watson.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hilton's 2 scores lead Colts over Texans 20-14

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson carried a career-high 37 times for 159 yards and Drew Stanton threw two touchdown passes to lead the Arizona Cardinals to a 20-10 victory over the winless San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson carries Cardinals to 20-10 victory over 49ers

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins drove Washington 70 yards in 35 seconds, capped by Rob Kelley's 1-yard touchdown run with less than a minute remaining, and the Washington Redskins rallied late to stun the Seattle Seahawks 17-14 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins comes through late as Washington stuns Seattle 17-14

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott ran for the go-ahead touchdown after another reprieve from his six-game suspension and the Dallas Cowboys overcame Tyreek Hill's improbable last-play touchdown in the first half, beating the Kansas City Chiefs 28-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elliott, Cowboys top improbable Hill TD to beat Chiefs 28-17

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw for 300 yards and the Oakland Raiders overcame two fluky plays that cost them possession to beat the Miami Dolphins 27-24 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr throws for 300 yards to help Oakland beat Miami 27-24

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford passed for 361 yards and two touchdowns to Marvin Jones, and the Detroit Lions snapped a three-game losing streak with a 30-17 win on Monday night over the offensively challenged Green Bay Packers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions win 30-17 as QB Matthew Stafford dissects Packers
